messages:
Evelyn: Heads-up: PR 5177 includes a migration section but it's wordy and duplicates SDK changelog entries. Can we make a concise migration note and add a small code snippet for the JS SDK showing `trace_id_hex` usage?
Marco: I can trim it. Suggest we include a tiny table that maps old param names -> new names, and then a single JS example with before/after. Keeps the doc scannable.
DevDocsBot: Reminder: PR 5177 failed link check: docs/console/tracing.md -> broken link to /sdk/js/CHANGELOG#v2.1. See CI logs.
Chris: I'll fix the changelog anchor and re-run the link-check workflow. Also reword suggestion: don't repeat wording from SDK changelog; point to it and provide a minimal migration snippet.
Evelyn: Cool. Minimal snippet suggestion:```diff
- await client.trace({ trace_id: 'abcd' })
+ await client.trace({ trace_id_hex: '0x' + 'abcd' })
```
Marco: Works for me. I'll update PR to replace the long paragraph with a 3-line migration note and the snippet, plus a pointer to the SDK changelog.
Evelyn: Thanks. I'll also update the PR template checklist to include 'link-checker passed' so we don't merge broken anchors.
